_comment: Fields the game plugin binds from GET /api/v1/focus and /api/v1/processes.
Generated from the plugin's Core/FocusedProtocol.cs; every field the plugin
declares MUST exist in the payload, and the payload MUST stay flat, because
Unity's JsonUtility binds public fields and primitive arrays only -- a nested
object arrives null with no error.  When the plugin's DTO changes, update this
file in the same pull request.
